_comment: Crew of Lakeshore Outpost. Original characters, all adults. No likeness of real people. Portrait files are SI-generated (watermarked) and optional: both editions must look complete without them. Portions generated with the assistance of an SI tool (Claude) and reviewed by Team PlutonyX.

crew.name: Ana Reyes
crew.bio: Ana grew up above a flower shop. She names every plant in the greenhouse after a river on Earth. The two tomato vines are Amu and Syr.
crew.loves: The garden. It took her ten years to earn these seeds a ticket to Mars.
crew.voice: Warm, patient, a little stubborn. Talks to plants first and people second.
crew.arc: If the garden lives, Ana proves an outpost can feed itself. If it dies, she quietly starts again with the last saved seeds.

crew.name: Dilnoza Karimova
crew.bio: Dil grew up in Samarkand, a city where people have mapped the stars for six hundred years. As a kid she asked one question until everyone was tired of it: are we alone?
crew.loves: The Leopard Core, a rock sample that might hold a clue.
crew.voice: Quick, curious, always looking at the horizon. Jokes when she is nervous.
crew.arc: Dil must learn that a question can wait and a crew cannot. Or the Commander must learn to trust her.

crew.name: Kofi Mensah
crew.bio: Kofi keeps the air, the power and the radio alive. He fixes things while he talks, and he talks while he fixes things.
crew.loves: His family's messages. His birthday is on Sol 5.
crew.fears: A problem he cannot reach with a wrench.
crew.voice: Calm, dry humour, never in a hurry until he is.
crew.arc: Kofi gives up his own comforts first. The Commander decides whether he should have to.

crew.name: Sam Whitfield
crew.bio: Sam has brought four crews home. Every word Sam says to you is already minutes old when you hear it.
crew.voice: Steady and kind. Ends messages with 'Lakeshore, we are with you.'
crew.arc: Sam has to let go and trust the people who can actually see the sky over Mars.

crew.name: PIP
crew.bio: PIP shows the numbers, reads them aloud if you like, and explains big words. PIP never decides for you.
crew.arc: By Sol 10, PIP stops giving hints because you no longer need them.

plants._comment: Ana names every plant after a river on Earth. Crops are ones that really grew on the International Space Station (see sources: nasa-veggie, osdr-268, osdr-766).

beds.name: Nile
beds.note: The lettuce type 'Outredgeous' grew on the ISS

beds.name: Volta
beds.note: Mizuna also grew on the ISS

beds.name: Lena
beds.note: Kale grew on the ISS in 2018

beds.name: Zarafshan
beds.note: Flowers for morale. Zinnias bloomed on the ISS
